Next time, I will prioritize "Acceptance" as the dominant emotion (score > 6) because the dialogue shows her acknowledging the link ("But that's not why I'm here..."), while lowering "Annoyance" and "Resentment" to reflect that her resistance is more about confusion or fear than active malice.
